fields.name: nav
fields.label: Navigation
fields.description: Nav document for this page (e.g. /jsw-nav). Leave empty for the site default /nav.

fields.name: footer
fields.label: Footer
fields.description: Footer document path, or "off" to hide the footer. Leave empty for the site default /footer.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Section Name
fields.description: The label shown for this section in the Content Tree

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Shown at the top of the card, between the arrows (e.g. OUR BLOGS).

fields.name: image
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Full-screen image behind the card; it fades in as the background turns dark. A soft, blurred image works best.

fields.name: eyebrow
fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.description: Small line above the title, e.g. LEARN MORE / NEV & PHEV.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link
fields.description: The blog post the READ MORE bar opens.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: First paragraph: year (e.g. 1924). Then a heading for the title, then the description.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Fills the hero behind the heading (cropped to fit; the design's cool tone is added over it).

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Background image alt text
fields.description: Describe the photo for screen readers, e.g. People in silhouette before a city skyline. Leave empty if it is only decorative.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: The page's main heading, e.g. THE WORLD NEEDS PIONEERS (it wraps onto two lines).

fields.name: description
fields.label: Subheading / description
fields.description: Optional: a short paragraph under the heading.

fields.name: ctaLabel
fields.label: Button label
fields.description: E.g. SCROLL or VIEW OPENINGS. Leave empty for no button.

fields.name: ctaLink
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: #open-roles scrolls smoothly down to the Job Board on this page (any #anchor: to the element with that id, else to the job board); a page path or URL opens that page.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Centred above the perks, e.g. OUR PERKS.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.description: Under the heading, centred. Start a new line where the text should break (otherwise it wraps by itself).

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: The line icon above the title.

fields.name: iconImage
fields.label: Custom icon image
fields.description: Optional: an image (ideally a square SVG with a 2px line) shown instead of the icon above, at 28 × 28.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Up to 64 characters. The block shows up to 6 perks (the first 6 in the content tree).

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Two or three short lines under the title.

fields.name: media_imageAlt
fields.label: Image Alt
fields.description: Describe the artwork, e.g. 'New Delhi Experience Centre'

fields.name: media_mobileImage
fields.label: Mobile image (portrait, below 600px)
fields.description: Optional. Portrait artwork (e.g. 1080x1920) shown on phones.

fields.name: linkText
fields.label: Link Text
fields.description: Read by screen readers, e.g. 'New Delhi Experience Centre - Know more'

fields.name: media_mobileImage
fields.label: Mobile image (day, square, below 900px)
fields.description: Optional. Square transparent cut-out shown on phones/tablets.

fields.name: night_mobileImage
fields.label: Mobile image (night, square, below 900px)
fields.description: Optional. Square transparent cut-out shown on phones/tablets.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Layout
fields.description: Variant A: the big word on a spotlight with the car in front, text centred below. Variant B: the image on the left, the text beside it.

options.name: Variant A – Reserved (spotlight, word and car)
Variant B – All set (image beside the text)

fields.name: displayWord
fields.label: Background word
fields.description: Variant A: the large word behind the car, e.g. RESERVED (not used by Variant B).

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Status heading
fields.description: E.g. YOU’RE IN, {firstName}. Values of the reservation (from the form, or the page address) fill {firstName}, {lastName}, {email}, {mobile}, {city}; {name|fallback} shows the fallback when there is none, otherwise the value and its comma are left out.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: E.g. We’ll message you when allocation opens. Your receipt is on its way to {email|your inbox}. Variant A shows each sentence on its own line. Values as in the heading.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Variant A: the car, cut out on a transparent background, in front of the word. Variant B: the photo on the left.

fields.name: background
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Variant A: fills the block behind the word and the car (decorative; not used by Variant B).

fields.name: ctaLink
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: Optional: a button under the description (none in the designs).

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Headline
fields.description: Stays at the top of the left column for every engine.

fields.name: media_image
fields.label: Engine image
fields.description: High-resolution image shown large on the right (hotspot positions are relative to it). Its alt text is generated from the engine type, e.g. "Battery Electric Vehicle engine".

fields.name: media_thumbnail
fields.label: Thumbnail image
fields.description: Shown on the thumbnail card (bottom left). Leave empty to use the engine image.

fields.name: media_framing
fields.label: Image framing
fields.description: Optional zoom and centre, e.g. "1.38 58% 52%": zoom relative to showing the whole image, then the image centre as left% top% of the display; add "flip" to mirror the image. Default: 1 50% 50%.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Engine type
fields.description: E.g. Battery Electric Vehicle. Also used for the engine image alt text and the thumbnail label.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Plain text shown under the engine type.

fields.name: hotspots
fields.label: Hotspots
fields.description: Up to 4 hotspots (any more are ignored), one paragraph each: position | TITLE | description, e.g. "18% 76% | INTELLIGENT SWITCHING | Automatically alternates…". Position is x y in % of the engine image, measured from its bottom-left corner ("18 76" works too). In the editor you can also drag a + on the image to move it: its position is saved here.

fields.name: mobileImage
fields.label: Mobile image (portrait, below 600px)
fields.description: Optional. Shown on phones instead of the main image.

fields.name: media_video
fields.label: Background video
fields.description: MP4 (H.264) or WebM file. Plays muted, looped and without controls.

fields.name: media_poster
fields.label: Poster image
fields.description: Shown while the video loads, when it can't play, and with reduced motion.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Headline and description
fields.description: A heading (top left) followed by a paragraph (bottom left).

fields.name: gallery
fields.label: Gallery image
fields.description: The photo strip under the board, across the full width. Optional.

fields.name: emptyMessage
fields.label: No results message
fields.description: Shown when no job matches the search and filters, e.g. No roles match your search.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: The heading's first line, in grey, e.g. OPEN ROLES AT.

fields.name: headingEmphasis
fields.label: Heading (second line)
fields.description: The heading's second line, in black, e.g. JSW MOTORS.

fields.name: placeholder
fields.label: Search input placeholder
fields.description: Shown inside the empty search box, e.g. Search Roles.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Under the search box.

fields.name: filterLabel
fields.label: Filters label
fields.description: Above the dropdowns, e.g. Filter Roles.

fields.name: locationLabel
fields.label: Location dropdown label
fields.description: Shown in the dropdown while no location is chosen (it then lists every location), e.g. Locations.

fields.name: locations
fields.label: Locations
fields.description: The location dropdown's choices: add, edit, reorder or remove them here, e.g. Bangalore, India. A choice shows the jobs whose Job location is the same (or starts with it: Mumbai also shows Mumbai, India). Left empty, the dropdown lists the jobs' own locations.

fields.name: departmentLabel
fields.label: Department dropdown label
fields.description: Shown in the dropdown while no department is chosen (it then lists every department), e.g. Departments.

fields.name: departments
fields.label: Departments
fields.description: The department dropdown's choices: add, edit, reorder or remove them here. A choice shows the jobs whose Department is the same. Left empty, the dropdown lists the jobs' own departments.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Job title
fields.description: Up to 64 characters. The board shows up to 15 jobs (the first 15 in the content tree).

fields.name: department
fields.label: Department
fields.description: Shown under the title; one of the Filters' departments (written the same way), e.g. Hardware and Embedded Engineering.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Job location
fields.description: Shown with the pin; one of the Filters' locations, e.g. Bangalore, India. Several, separated by semicolons, for a job in more than one place: Mumbai, India; Pune, India.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Job description
fields.description: A short line under the department and location (up to 64 characters; the search also looks in it).

fields.name: applyLink
fields.label: Apply button link
fields.description: Where the button leads: a page, a URL or a mailto: address.

fields.name: applyLabel
fields.label: Apply button label
fields.description: E.g. APPLY NOW.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Column title
fields.description: E.g. TECHNOLOGY. The column's links are its children (+ adds one).

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link
fields.description: A page, a URL or a mailto: address.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Column title
fields.description: E.g. CONNECT. The social links are its children (+ adds one).

fields.name: network
fields.label: Network
fields.description: Its icon, and the link's name for screen readers.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Profile link
fields.description: The network's page, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/…

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Layout
fields.description: Variant A: the brand, button and columns over the background image. Variant B: one row (brand, button, columns, social squares without their title) on a black-to-teal gradient (no background image).

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: The JSW MOTORS wordmark (white, on transparent).

fields.name: logoAlt
fields.label: Logo alt text
fields.description: E.g. JSW Motors.

fields.name: logoLink
fields.label: Logo link
fields.description: Where the logo leads, e.g. the home page.

fields.name: copyright
fields.label: Copyright
fields.description: E.g. © 2026 JSW Motors.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: Beside the copyright, e.g. Mumbai, India.

fields.name: ctaLink
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: The white button under the copyright, e.g. the reservation form.

fields.name: ctaLinkText
fields.label: Button label
fields.description: E.g. REGISTER INTEREST (a + follows it).

fields.name: legalLink
fields.label: Legal link
fields.description: At the bottom left, e.g. the privacy policy.

fields.name: legalLinkText
fields.label: Legal link label
fields.description: E.g. PRIVACY POLICY.

fields.name: background
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Variant A: fills the footer behind everything (dark at the top, where the texts sit). Not used by Variant B (its gradient).

fields.name: position
fields.label: Position (optional)
fields.description: Optional. "large" marks the hero image that shrinks to the top (default: the first image). Images then fill screen 1 (4 cards) and screen 2 (4 cards) in order.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Car image
fields.description: Fills the left half of the block (on phones: a banner above the form).

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: E.g. RESERVE NOW.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown under the heading.

fields.name: submitLabel
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: E.g. PROCEED.

fields.name: submitAction
fields.label: Send the form to (URL)
fields.description: The form data is posted there as JSON ({ data: { firstName, … } }). Leave empty to only show the confirmation message.

fields.name: successMessage
fields.label: Confirmation message
fields.description: Replaces the form once it has been sent.

fields.name: disclaimer
fields.label: Privacy disclaimer
fields.description: Small print under the button, e.g. “… or request erasure anytime at”. The contact email and the privacy notice link follow it, each with a full stop.

fields.name: privacyEmail
fields.label: Privacy contact email
fields.description: Shown as a link after the disclaimer: the address as mailto:…, e.g. mailto:privacy@jswmotors.com.

fields.name: privacyEmailText
fields.label: Privacy contact email text
fields.description: E.g. privacy@jswmotors.com.

fields.name: privacyLinkText
fields.label: Privacy notice link text
fields.description: E.g. Full Privacy Notice.

fields.name: amountLabel
fields.label: Amount label
fields.description: Shown on the price card over the image, e.g. RESERVATION AMOUNT. Leave the amount empty to hide the card.

fields.name: amount
fields.label: Reservation amount (₹)
fields.description: In rupees, e.g. 10000 (shown as ₹10,000). Also the amount charged when no payment service is set; with one, the service's amount is charged, so keep the two the same.

fields.name: amountBadge
fields.label: Amount badge
fields.description: The small outlined tag beside the label, e.g. REFUNDABLE. Optional.

fields.name: amountNote
fields.label: Amount note
fields.description: Under the amount, e.g. Total payable today. Refundable until you confirm your order.

fields.name: razorpayKeyId
fields.label: Razorpay Key ID
fields.description: The PUBLIC key only (rzp_test_… or rzp_live_…). NEVER enter the Key Secret here: this page is public and anyone could read it. The secret belongs only in the payment service's settings. Leave empty to send the form without a payment.

validation.customErrorMsg: Enter the Key ID (rzp_test_… or rzp_live_…), never the Key Secret: this page is public.

fields.name: paymentService
fields.label: Payment service URL
fields.description: The address of the payment service that creates the orders and verifies the payments with the Key Secret, e.g. https://jsw-payments.example.workers.dev. Without it, payments are not verified (test mode only).

fields.name: merchantName
fields.label: Name in the payment window
fields.description: E.g. JSW Motors. The amount label is shown under it.

fields.name: successPage
fields.label: Page after a successful payment
fields.description: E.g. the Confirmation page (default: /confirmation).

fields.name: failurePage
fields.label: Page after a failed payment
fields.description: E.g. the Payment Failed page (default: /payment-failed).

fields.name: title
fields.label: Section name
fields.description: E.g. User Details. Groups the fields that follow it (up to the next section); read out by screen readers as the group's name (not shown in the design).

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Shown inside the field and read out by screen readers, e.g. First Name (required fields get a * added). The field’s kind follows its name: an email address, a mobile / phone number (with the +91 box) or text; first and last name sit side by side.

fields.name: fieldName
fields.label: Field name
fields.description: Key of this value in the sent data, e.g. firstName. Leave empty to make it from the label.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Shown in the dropdown until a choice is made, e.g. Select City (a required one gets a * added).

fields.name: fieldName
fields.label: Field name
fields.description: Key of the choice in the sent data, e.g. city. Leave empty to make it from the label.

fields.name: options
fields.label: Cities
fields.description: The dropdown’s choices: add a city per entry, edit, reorder or remove them here.
